result.title: MAGIC: Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration for VLM Test-time Robustness Scaling
result.summary: This paper studies the problem of test-time robustness scaling for large vision-language models (LVLMs), which aims to mitigate language bias during inference. Existing approaches typically adopt test-time scaling techniques such as contrastive decoding to improve inference performance. Despite the progress, the performance of these approaches is far from satisfactory due to intentional evidence removal during perturbations and redundant inference cost. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration (MAGIC). The core of our MAGIC is to evaluate the decision margins of LVLMs to selectively activate textual and visual perturbation branches for efficient debiased inference. In particular, our MAGIC first measures the prediction margins of crucial tokens, and applies a gating function to identify low-confidence responses that are susceptible to language biases. For selected samples, we integrate the token logits from multiple textual and image perturbation branches with the original ones for debiased decision. More importantly, we selectively restore the most informative corrupted views with sharp prediction distributions for ambiguous samples after debiasing, enabling evidence recovery for discriminative decision-making. We further utilize a calibration dataset to actively identify and prune ineffective branches during contrastive debiasing for cost reduction. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed MAGIC in comparison with extensive baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 LVLM 测试时鲁棒性 scaling，提出 MAGIC：依据关键 token 的决策 margin 门控，选择性启用文本与视觉扰动分支进行对比去偏，并恢复模糊样本中信息量高的损坏视图，再用校准集剪枝无效分支以降低推理成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及视觉证据是否被语言先验旁路、扰动视图筛选及动态计算成本；其 margin 门控与分支剪枝可供核查 LOOK/STOP 的条件和收益，但未涉及 latent 状态生成，证据恢复是否真正改变内部决策仍待阅读验证。
